seo_title: Lanevia | AI dash cam and consent-first road data
seo_description: Lanevia's RoadSense One dash cam detects work zones, closures and hazards on the device and shares road data only with each driver's permission.
hero_title: A dash cam that maps the road, not the driver.
hero_text: RoadSense One records the road ahead, spots work zones and closures with on-device AI, and shares that road data only with the buyers you approve. When your data is used, you earn a credit on your bill.

features_title: Built for commuters. Designed for privacy.

features.title: On-device road AI
features.text: Detects work zones, lane closures, road closures, potholes and debris as you drive, with a confidence score for each.

features.title: Privacy before upload
features.text: Faces and license plates are blurred on the camera before anything reaches the cloud. Audio stays off unless you turn it on.

features.title: You choose every buyer
features.text: Approve or decline each buyer and each data level separately, and change your mind any time in the app.

features.title: Free cloud backup
features.text: Your own clips are backed up for free, and you can export all of your footage if you ever leave.

features.title: Get paid back
features.text: Each month, a quarter of the license revenue your data earns comes back to you as a bill credit.

features.title: Fair terms
features.text: Short contracts, a cancellation fee shown before you buy, and no surprises in the fine print.

snapshot_text: A sample of the road events the network detected in the demo dataset. Coordinates are shown for the road, never linked to a driver.
